dogecoin.text: It’s NOT a winner take all game!!! There are many utilities for each crypto, even if only as a value store. Some shitcoins like Dogecoin and Bitcoin may hold value forever, even if they never become platforms for DeFi, NFT, Etc.

$BTC - v1 tech, becoming a Ponzi scheme? $ETH - v2 tech, Proof of Concept, dated. $ETH2 - v3 tech, may not work. $HBAR - Fortune 500. $XRP - Banks. $NFT - Banksy (blockchain apps). $UNI - Lend & Borrow. $ADA - v3 for u and me. $DOT - baby ADA. $DOGE - @elonmusk is trying to fix.
@IOHK_Charles Let’s not conflate smarts with luck. Comparing $ADA to $DOGE is like comparing an iPad to a pet rock. #Cardano
